title: Turkish LLM Multi-Axis Evaluation Suite: code and per-item results for the ASYU 2026 paper
description:
Code and per-item results for A Multi-Axis Comparative Evaluation of Turkish Large Language Models across Knowledge, Reasoning, and Reliability (ASYU 2026, IEEE, doi:10.1109/ASYU71790.2026.11772376).

Seven open-weight Turkish LLMs are evaluated on six benchmarks under one shared protocol: CosmosGemma-9B, Trendyol-7B v0.1, Trendyol-7B v4.1, WiroAI-9B, WiroAI-8B, KoçDigital-8B and Kumru-2B-Base. The benchmarks are MMLU-TR, ARC-TR, HellaSwag-TR, GSM8K-TR, TruthfulQA-TR (MC1/MC2) and HalluVerse-M3. Multiple-choice tasks are scored by log-likelihood. Generation tasks use greedy decoding with seed 42. All models are loaded in 4-bit NF4. Pairwise differences are tested with McNemar's test, and scores carry Wilson 95% confidence intervals.

The release contains:

  • the evaluation notebook as run, with outputs removed;
  • per-model, per-item 0/1 results;
  • a hash-only manifest of the evaluated subsets;
  • scripts that recompute every confidence interval and McNemar test without a GPU, and that check a rebuilt subset.

No benchmark text is redistributed. A known issue in ARC-TR answer-key indexing is documented in the README.

Changes from v1.0.0. v2.0.0 is the version used for the published paper. It adds log-likelihood scoring, the TruthfulQA MC protocol, deterministic decoding, fixed shared subsets and statistical testing. It replaces the pre-review pipeline.
